P_0x001BDC.en: Captain of Langran's Ruzak border guard, lieutenant rank. Courteous, well-mannered. Senior alumnus of Masaki's mentor Zeolute's academy.

P_0x002C58.en: A Kirkus soldier, a magic officer skilled in sorcery. Fastidious and obsessed with justice.

P_0x008924.en: Tests Medius Locus, a TE Absorber from the Zentle Project. Ex-captain of "Craywolves," <Earth Fed>'s 3rd Special Ops <PT> Unit. Strict, dutiful.

P_0x00A244.en: Commander of "GS," the Gaia Sabers, under the <Earth Fed Gov't> President. Near the <Inspector Incident> she approached Graien Grusman via Nibhal Mubhal, earning a special post. Cold, ambitious.

P_0x00CCE5.en: President of <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>, daughter of ex-president Renji Isurugi (died in <L5 Campaign>). Gentle, shrewd beauty; puts profit first, picky about neither methods nor partners.

P_0x00F25B.en: Upper house member, <Earth Fed Gov't> parliament. Aqua Centrum's father. Serious, doting, worries constantly about Aqua, who ran off to join the military.

U_0x0045EE.en: A humanoid mobile weapon of the Machinery Children. A Mass-Prod Huckebein Mk-II remade with <Machine Cell> for new form and higher specs. Mounts the <Geim System> and remote weapons; its <Machine Cell> frame self-repairs.

U_0x00B141.en: An <Armored Module> based on a Galerion prototype, customized for the <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet its <Tesla Drive> and thrusters outdo the Asterion AX.
